tool_input.description: Check notification usage in api hooks and lint rule

result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments from the comments list. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked. I checked the code by reading it, and git status was blocked by the permission gate, so I couldn't confirm the diff that way.

What changed, all under `apps/react-vite`:

- **API** (`src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`): `updateComment` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. It uses a zod schema and a `useUpdateComment` hook that refreshes the comments list. The success notification ("Comment Updated") lives in this hook, following the new `features/CLAUDE.md` rule.
- **UI** (`src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`): an "Edit" button opens a form drawer with a prefilled body textarea. It closes on success, following the existing create and update drawers.
- **List** (`comments-list.tsx`): the Edit button is wrapped in a new `comment:update` policy, so it only appears on comments whose author is the current user.
- **Policy** (`src/lib/authorization.tsx`): `comment:update` allows only the author. Admins can delete other people's comments but cannot edit them, which is what "own comments only" asked for.
- **Mock API** (`src/testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`): a PATCH handler so the dev app works. It returns 403 unless the requester is the comment's author.

Things you may want to decide on:

- The existing delete wrapper in `comments-list.tsx` wraps the whole header row, including the date and author. That means a regular user does not see those on other people's comments. I left that as it was, since changing it alters what everyone sees.
- The existing create and delete comment components still put their notifications in the components. Moving them into the hooks would follow the new rule, but I left them alone as out of scope.
- `features/CLAUDE.md` says the rule is enforced by `no-restricted-imports`, but I found no such rule in the lint config, so nothing checks it yet.
- I did not create a `notes/` folder, since the project has none yet. Say if you want one started.
